notablePrerequisites:
Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least two additional creatures.
It is your upkeep.
description:
During your upkeep, activate Necrotic Ooze using Whisper's ability by tapping it and sacrificing two other creatures, returning Triplicate Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Black Carriage's ability by sacrificing Triplicate Titan.
When Triplicate Titan dies, it triggers, creating three 3/3 Golem artifact creature tokens.
Resolve the Necrotic Ooze ability, untapping it.
Repeat.
